rules.title: Annual allowable rent increase for rent-controlled units, March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027
rules.requirement: If you live in a rent-controlled unit in San Francisco, your landlord's annual increase for March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is limited to 1.6% of your base rent. For example, on a $2,000 base rent the increase is $32, for a new base rent of $2,032.

coverage.summary: Applies to rent-controlled units in San Francisco. This announcement does not define which units are rent-controlled.

rules.quoted_span: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.

notes: Rent Board announcement of the annual allowable increase. The page does not cite a code section; the citation is the SF Rent Ordinance section that governs annual allowable increases. The page does not define coverage of 'rent-controlled units', so the coverage fields are left null. The prior-year figure (1.4% for 3/1/25–2/28/26) expired before the query date and was not extracted as a separate rule.
